scope: Personal DSH Semantic UI project. Public sources only. No company code, private adapters, credentials or user data.
method: Repository metadata and immutable default-branch commit; fetched README, license, selected package manifests and selected contract/implementation files. Not a full security audit or runtime test of every project. Selection judgments are original.
versionBoundary: manifestObservations describe pinned source trees, including prereleases/private roots; they are not a registry latest-version claim. Existing installed versions remain separately pinned.
licenseBoundary: Top-level source licenses are recorded for research, not a blanket license of optional products, assets or every dependency. No upstream code was copied into implementation; existing production license inventory is maintained separately.
benchmarkBoundary: Upstream token, latency, bundle and performance claims were not reproduced. No universal ranking by stars or chart count.
